description: Unique identifier for each knowledge base entry
Topic cluster for filtering (e.g., HORMUZ, HIDDEN_CRE, SHALE)
Most specific entity the fact is about (company, country, instrument)

allowed_values: Free text (one atomic claim per row)
description: The claim itself — precise, sourced, quantified where possible
Where the claim came from (e.g., "BLS CPI Report Feb 2026")
Admiralty digraph — letter (A-F) = source reliability, number (1-6) = information credibility
Nature of the claim: EMPIRICAL (observed/measured), ESTIMATE (derived/projected), ASSUMPTION (believed but unverified)
Expected review/expiration date; empty if the fact is static or atemporal
Parent KB entries this claim was built on (provenance chain)
Catch-all: caveats, assumptions, gaps, implications, verification instructions
